title: Complete the Settings locale catalog
description: Extend the existing dependency-free typed locale catalog with one complete SettingsCatalog and use it across the current /settings surface. Catalog every Gateship-authored visible label, title, description, state label, button, placeholder, empty state, fallback and pluralized count rendered by SettingsSurface and its existing Project, Operator, Providers, Model settings, Chained runs, Self-update, Diagnostic schedule, Notifications, Project brief and Handoff panels. Keep existing en-US wording and behavior as the production baseline and add complete pt-BR equivalents. Thread the already-selected catalog through those existing components without adding a context, translation runtime or state store. Locale-sensitive dates, times, percentages and counts on this surface must use the selected locale. Preserve factual and operator-authored values verbatim: repository/ref, project detail, name, IANA timezone, provider/model/effort/plan identifiers, usage facts, channel ids, version/commit, brief and handoff contents, commands and runtime error detail. Translate only the Gateship-owned framing around those values. Extend existing static-render tests in place with representative populated, empty, enabled/disabled and actionable /settings states in both locales, asserting exact product-owned labels and unchanged factual/authored values. Do not add a wording grep, snapshot test or score. Update HANDOFF.md only to record that /settings is cataloged and onboarding remains before a production locale selector. Preserve provider selection/login, model writes, chain policy, self-update, diagnostic schedule, notification tests, brief writes and every same-origin/action contract. Out of scope: onboarding, locale selection or persistence, browser-language inference, server/API/error localization, new endpoints, dependencies, panels, routes, database or runtime lifecycle changes.
